title: Brand Governance v0.2: bounded review dispositions, not action
summary: Brand Intervention Governance consumes Effectiveness evidence and an exact Institutional Policy selection to produce bounded, non-executing review dispositions. There is no implicit operative governance rule set.
invariants: recommend(binding) without explicit rules fails GOVERNANCE_RULE_SET_REQUIRED.
The managed path consumes an Institutional Policy catalogue resolution and retains exact policy/deployment/publication authority evidence.
Unmanaged recommendations cannot seal positive exposure-increasing decisions.
Guardrails remain distinct outcomes; there is no scalar utility score.
Named domain authority remains separate from Institutional Policy publication/deployment authority.
Governance decisions still require an external execution component.
Service-as-Sales significance does not confer sales authority.

provenance.claim: Governance consumes effectiveness evidence and separates Brand semantics from Institutional Policy selection.
No implicit operative policy; managed and explicit unmanaged paths and positive-exposure restriction.
Core governance rules and non-executing review dispositions.
